svg.text: FIT · PE · PART 4.1 — WHEN THE NUMBERS MOVE
PART 4 · THE DIAGNOSTIC PLAYBOOK — run the ladder, don't panic.
A marker drifting the wrong way is data about your dose, not an emergency to medicate away. For every number you run the same five rungs —
confirm it's real, fix the free cause, adjust the protocol, add the clever ancillary, pull the dose back — and they all end at the same rung.
Two readings skip the ladder and go straight to the ER. Everything else, you work the tree.
A MARKER IS DATA ABOUT YOUR DOSE, NOT AN OBSTACLE TO IT
CONFIRM → CAUSE → PROTOCOL → ANCILLARY → PULL BACK
THE TEMPLATE LADDER — learn it once, read all 16
every marker is a copy of this · same five rungs, same order
Is it real? rested / fasted, right cuff, repeat
the draw, a trend not one bad night.
The free levers: sleep, hydration, sodium /
The dose, the compound, the injection frequency.
The double-duty Rx: statin, telmisartan, SGLT2i,
GATE · physician only · WHICH one = Part 4.2
The pre-decided value where the honest answer is

g.text: DESCEND ONLY AS FAR AS YOU NEED · the drug is rung 4, not rung 1

svg.text: most markers settle by rung 2–3 — you reach the Rx only after the free levers are spent.
⇅ E2 & SHBG fail HIGH or LOW — crashed is as bad as high.
target IN RANGE, never "as low as possible"
The cluster that actually kills. It comes first, and notice how many entries converge.
FIX IT UPSTREAM — dose · hematocrit · estradiol — and BP, lipids, RHR/HRV settle together. RHR↑/HRV↓ is the canary; sudden weight is an early BP warning.
they compound — fix upstream, several settle

g.text: fast kilos = water, early BP flag

svg.text: the only two reds on this board
confirm the fast / thyroid triad first
high AND low are both failure states
minimum AI only if truly high
E2 & SHBG fail high OR low.
crashed is as bad as high —
Blood work is the final arbiter. If confirming, fixing the cause, adjusting the protocol and adding the right ancillary all fail — the answer is not a stronger ancillary.
It's LESS drug, or none. The cycle serves your markers, not the reverse (Part 1 · Part 3.2).
HDL · BP · hematocrit · HbA1c — set them
BEFORE you're emotionally invested in a cycle.

KEY: each marker = one 5-rung ladder · all ladders drain to PULL BACK · red chute = skip the rack → ER · ⇅ = fails high OR low
harm reduction, not medical advice — every named drug is physician territory; a crisis is care, not troubleshooting.
